title: OB Profile Schema
description: The profile of occupant behavior in an household for stochastic schedule generation.

occupancy.description: The occupancy of the household (number of occupants, household composition, occupancy patterns).

num_occupants.description: The number of occupants in the household.

fulltime_workers.description: Number of full-time workers in the household.

hybrid_workers.description: Number of hybrid workers in the household.

stayathome.description: Number of mostly at home individuals (remote worker, kids, retired, stayathome parent) in the household.

k12.description: Number of K-12 students in the household.

college_students.description: Number of college students in the household.

weekday_no_one_home.description: Indicate the time range when no one is home on weekdays.

start_hour.description: Hour of the day (0-23) when no one is home

end_hour.description: Hour of the day (0-23) when someone returns home

weekend_no_one_home.description: Indicate the time range when no one is home on weekdays.

start_hour.description: Hour of the day (0-23) when no one is home

end_hour.description: Hour of the day (0-23) when someone returns home

weekday_sleep_time.description: Indicate the typical sleep time range on weekdays.

lastest_start_hour.description: Hour of the day (0-23) when occupants typically go to sleep

earliest_end_hour.description: Hour of the day (0-23) when occupants typically wake up

weekend_sleep_time.description: Indicate the typical sleep time range on weekends.

lastest_start_hour.description: Hour of the day (0-23) when occupants typically go to sleep

earliest_end_hour.description: Hour of the day (0-23) when occupants typically wake up
